t: A tiny Arm chip from Puya that costs about a dime in bulk.
steps: Buy a PY32F002A core board from a marketplace or build one from the open wagiminator design files.
Get a USB-serial adapter or an SWD debug probe such as a J-Link.
Install VS Code and the free GNU Arm GCC compiler.
Download the community py32f0-template from GitHub.
Wire the adapter to the board's serial or SWD pins.
Build the blink example and flash it with pyOCD or the factory serial bootloader.
Change the blink speed in the code and flash it again.
meta: Wild Open. From $0.20. A few stores.
